surface_name: REST API, Yoast SEO post meta
title: Writing Yoast fields through the WordPress REST API silently does nothing
symptoms: POST /wp/v2/posts/{id} with meta returns 200 but the Yoast title is unchanged
The meta key reads back absent
cause: Yoast's meta keys such as _yoast_wpseo_title, _yoast_wpseo_metadesc and _yoast_wpseo_focuskw are not registered for REST, so writes to them are dropped. An unregistered key reads back absent, which looks the same as an empty field.
fix: Register each key with show_in_rest for the post type, then write and confirm through yoast_head_json.
apply: foreach (['_yoast_wpseo_title','_yoast_wpseo_metadesc','_yoast_wpseo_focuskw'] as $k) { register_post_meta('post', $k, ['show_in_rest' => true, 'single' => true, 'type' => 'string', 'auth_callback' => fn() => current_user_can('edit_posts')]); }
affected: WordPress REST API with Yoast SEO Premium, August 2026
